nom: Doré La Micellaire Botanical Micellar Cleansing Water

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the product as gentle and moisturizing without stripping, though one reviewer with dry skin describes a chemical burn and severe drying instead.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, no redness and no breakouts, but one reviewer says the product turned her skin red with a burning sensation.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer reports the product cleans and removes makeup while still leaving skin hydrated, unlike other micellar waters that stripped it.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the product does not dry out their skin and even feels moisturizing; one reviewer reports the opposite, describing severe dryness and the need to moisturize repeatedly after a burning reaction.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her whole face turned red with a skin burn after use, while others with sensitive skin explicitly report no redness.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers describe a chemical burn or severe irritation lasting days, while most others report no irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with fungal acne reports her breakouts finally cleared after stripping her routine down to this product plus zinc soap and a basic moisturizer; a sensitive, acne-prone reviewer reports no new breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Fails to remove makeup or mascara
Comparisons unfavorable to Garnier or Bioderma
Leaves filmy residue requiring harder rubbing

extraits.texte: this Dore micellar water caused me chemical burn, severe irritation that lasted for days and it completely dried my skin out. I have never had a product cause that dryness to my face. I have had to moisturize several times a day to restore my skin.

I got this as a free sample, and so glad I did. It is gentle and moisturizing on my dry, sensitive skin. I do need to use a separate product to remove waterproof mascara. But wouldn't expect a gentle cleansing water to be able to take off tough waterproof mascara. Not even the micellar waters that say they can remove, work on my waterproof mascara. I don't understand any negative reviews on this product.
I have super sensitive skin and this makes my skin feel so good. It doesnt irritate or dry out my skin either. I recommend this over any of micellar water!

I LOVE this micellar water. It removes all of my makeup, and is the perfect precleanse before going in with an actual face wash. I have very sensitive and acne prone skin. This doesn't break me out at all.

This micellar water is what got my fungal acne to FINALLY clear up! After a year of relentless, horrible pimples on my temples and forehead, and wasting SOOOOOO much money on products thaf only made it worse. I found this, completely stripped my routine down to this, zinc soap bar, and a basic moisturizer, and my skin looks and feels the best it has in years!
DOES NOT DISAPPOINT!! So many Micellar waters seemed to strip and dry out my skin but this one cleans and removes my makeup while still leaving it hydrated.
